name: THE ASSAY OFFICE
materialIdentity: grey, bone, glass, brass -- cold precision (errata ruling 17b)
note: Doc 05 Room 5. FOUR of eight hotspots -- doc 05 writes out the window sign, scales, queue book and floorboard in full; the sample shelves, her pen, the certificate and the stove are listed as '(working script)' and that script is not in /docs. THE FLOORBOARD is unmarked and critical: Winnie's second ledger is under it and Act II turns on it. It carries no visual marking beyond a lit edge, and must never be given one.

LOOK_AT.say: THIS WINDOW CLOSES AT FOUR. Handwritten. The ink has faded but the sentiment has not.

LISTEN_TO.say: Nothing. It has been saying the same thing for six years and requires no assistance.

LOOK_AT.say: A balance, in a glass case, so accurate that men have wept in front of it. Mostly in the other direction.

LISTEN_TO.say: Nothing at all. It is the only instrument in Consolation that cannot be argued with.

LOOK_AT.say: Eight months of names. Two-thirds of them in the same hand.
A floorboard. It sits a little proud of the others.

LISTEN_TO.say: Loose. There's a space under it.
